name: Per-Opal-ETF, per-partner, monthly AVERAGE ownership value (partner AUM in Opal funds)
description: Andrew-direct. Track, per Opal ETF (DIVZ/IDVZ/PFDE/PFOE), per partner (49 Financial / Inflection Wealth Mgmt / Cottonwood Capital Advisors), per month, the monthly AVERAGE ownership VALUE = sum of position market_value across the partner's accounts holding the ETF, per day, averaged over the month (= the AUM each partner has placed in Opal's funds). Architecture: NEVER-cross-firm-bucket (CLAUDE.md #1) -> per-partner monthly-avg computed WITHIN each firm bucket -> published to a NEW deliberately-IAM'd opal-data-etfs aggregation bucket (the one audited cross-firm-read exception). Distinct from sibling ETFS_NETAST/ETFS_SECIDX (both complete).
